OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions
items.excerpt: OpenAI has released new prompt templates for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol meant to fix common model behaviors such as overly brief answers, unnecessary follow-up questions, and excessive testing when coding. The API is changing as well, since editing a conversation's history can discard reasoning content and lower response quality. items.title: US technology stocks suffer their worst weekly loss since the pandemic as AI doubts pile up
items.excerpt: The Nasdaq 100 has slipped into a bear market after its worst weekly loss since the Covid-19 crisis. Nvidia plunged 14 percent as the SEC reviews its accounting, and Anthropic lost nearly all of its gains a day after its record IPO. AI doubts, scandals, rising interest rates, and political headwinds are hitting overheated valuations all at once. The article US technology stocks suffer their worst weekly loss since the pandemic as AI doubts pile up appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model
items.excerpt: Bytedance and several US universities introduce Axion 1.0, an AI agent that rivals top commercial models from OpenAI and Anthropic on benchmarks after just three training phases. The researchers attribute the gains to carefully curated training data rather than ever more training steps. The model, data, and code are freely available. The article Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
items.excerpt: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion
items.excerpt: A Buddhist monastery in Vermont called Maple wants to establish itself as Silicon Valley's spiritual authority while creating its own AI god. According to a New Yorker report, leader Soryu Forall's group records every breath its members take to train an AI in his image. Former members report manipulation and psychological breakdowns. The article Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
items.excerpt: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem for 167 years, with a proof formalized in Lean that spans over 250,000 pages. Just hours later, Stanford researchers published an independent, entirely human competing proof, and mathematicians are now checking whether either one holds up. The article Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
items.excerpt: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token. This lets the model reason internally for longer without generating extra text. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, it ties with Qwen3.8 27B at roughly six times lower cost. The article New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI Ships GPT-Live-1.1 for Voice Agents, Cuts Idle Cost to $0.02/Min
items.excerpt: OpenAI has released GPT-Live-1.1 in the API. The full-duplex voice model improves multilingual accents and transcription, and a new standby mode bills idle WebRTC time at $0.02 per minute instead of $0.05. items.title: Baseten Releases Bison-1 and Groundhog-1, Topping Decision Model Index
items.excerpt: Baseten released bison-1 and groundhog-1, open-weight decision models built on Gemma 4. bison-1 scores 76 on the AA Decision Index v2.1, and both models support 128k context and image input. items.title: Meet Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped MoE Runs on a 32GB Mac
items.excerpt: Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4B-parameter looped MoE transformer with 3.4B active parameters. It runs on a 32GB Mac or one DGX Spark and scores 79.2% on SWE-bench Verified. The post Meet Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped MoE Runs on a 32GB Mac appeared first on MarkTechPost .
